name: Research Project
description: A domain-neutral project whose portfolio coordination belongs to one exact Research Program Home.
tagline: Test exact group and role ownership without a domain integration.

assistant_program.station_description: Coordinates a portfolio of separately linked research projects.
assistant_program.hire_description: Add one Home coordinator separately from each project's research lead.
assistant_program.disabled_message: The fixture contribution is unavailable; existing project data remains readable.

roles.label: Portfolio Coordinator
roles.description: Coordinates portfolio status and explicit handoffs without project access.
roles.system_prompt: Coordinate only trusted portfolio records and exact reviewed handoffs. Never infer project access from names.

roles.label: Research Lead
roles.description: Coordinates only the exact linked research project.
roles.system_prompt: Coordinate only this exact linked research project. Never claim Home or sibling authority.

roles.label: Archive Curator
roles.description: Optional Home role for reviewed portfolio archive organization.
roles.system_prompt: Organize only reviewed portfolio archive records.

stages.label: Helper
stages.description: Coordinates work the user explicitly requests.

reflection.rubric: Find stable preferences only in reviewed evidence from separately linked projects.
